messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Incident 3409876543 — unusual per-model request pattern detected: tide-7b RPM spiked ~3x for the past 6m, queue latency rising, a subset of customers reporting timeouts.
Maya (oncall): I'm paging SRE, system graphs show 95th latency edging up. customer-impact? any high-traffic keys?
Devin SRE: I'm on it. seeing increased short-burst chat traffic pinned to model family \"tide-7b\". TPM unchanged but RPM spike suggests bursty interactive sessions. No error spikes yet, just queued tokens.
Samir (eng-runtime): Also noticing KV cache churn for tide-7b leading to memory pressure. autotuner pushed batch size up which is amplifying tail latency.
Elaine (customer-ops): Heads-up: major customer \"PolarisAI\" in EU seeing 502s. They've opened a support ticket. They said recent rollout removed client-side rate-limiter.
Maya (oncall): Ok — plan: temporary per-model RPM cap for tide-7b, disable funcall for tide-7b, and route low-priority traffic to shore-3b. Will coordinate with platform for quota change. @Kevin can you apply?
Kevin (platform): I'll carve a per-model quota. Suggest RPM -> 120, TPM -> 2200 for tide-7b as immediate mitigation. Enabling routing rule to fallback shore-3b for requests matching weight<0.5.
Devin SRE: 👍 Do we have a quick rollback plan? Need a canary lift after 10m if queue clears. Also postmortem notes: record spike pattern and customer(s) involved.
Samir (eng-runtime): To disable funcall: toggling feature flag `funcall_enabled[tide-7b]=false`. Also will set dispatcher max-batch-size=32 for tide-7b to reduce per-request latency.
Kevin (platform): Executing commands now:
```
/rate-limit set --model tide-7b --rpm 120 --tpm 2200 --annotation "temporary mit: 3409876543"
/feature-toggle set funcall tide-7b false --by oncall
/route add --from tide-7b --to shore-3b --criteria "weight<0.5" --priority 50
```
Deploy Bot: deploy queued: quota-change (id qc-3409) applied successfully. funcall toggle propagated to 6/8 runtime shards.
Maya (oncall): Checking customer impact dashboard. Elaine, can you confirm PolarisAI's errors dropping?
Elaine (customer-ops): Confirmed: their error rate dropped from 7% -> 1.2% within 90s after the change. They're still seeing higher latency but no timeouts.
Devin SRE: Runtime metrics show queue depth halved. Tail latency 95p back within SLO on most shards. A couple of shards still catching up due to hot-keys.
Samir (eng-runtime): I've opened a temporary shard-level isolation for the hottest keys to stabilize KV cache. Will monitor 5m then consider increasing RPM if stable.
Maya (oncall): Noted. Action items: 1) keep tide-7b RPM at 120 for at least 10m, 2) monitor customer impact and shard health, 3) if stable after 10m, increment RPM to 180 for 5m canary.
Kevin (platform): Annotation added to quota-change and ticket linked: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-3409
Incident Bot: Incident 3409876543 acknowledged by oncall. Pager duty sequence active.
Devin SRE: Logging mitigation steps in the incident doc. Also capture the pre-mit metrics for later regression analysis.
Maya (oncall): Handoff in 20m to next oncall. Summarize status at handoff: tide-7b RPM=120, funcall disabled, routing fallback active, queue depth halved, PolarisAI error rate reduced. Will add customer comms draft.
Elaine (customer-ops): Draft sent to PolarisAI for review. Suggest we include ETA for feature re-enablement.
Samir (eng-runtime): 8m update: all runtime shards within SLO, KV churn down 70%. Recommend bump to RPM=180 canary.
Maya (oncall): Bump approved. Kevin, please increment to 180 and set a 5m canary.
Kevin (platform): Executing:
```
/rate-limit update --model tide-7b --rpm 180 --canary 300
```
Deploy Bot: quota update applied to 8/8 shards. Canary timer started.
Devin SRE: Monitoring canary window. If any shard shows >2x baseline tail latency or customer error regresses, auto-rollback will trigger.
Maya (oncall): 5m canary complete. No regressions. Proceed to gradual ramp to previous baseline by +50 RPM every 3m until normal.
Samir (eng-runtime): I'll re-enable funcall behind a feature-gate for select customers only. `funcall_beta_allowlist = [\"PolarisAI\"]` for now.
Elaine (customer-ops): PolarisAI approved funcall for their traffic. Communicated expected behavior.
Maya (oncall): Closing loop: will file a short RCA stub and schedule full postmortem if trend repeats. Handoff to Devin in 10m.
Devin SRE: Taking over. I'll maintain monitoring and prepare notes for postmortem. Thanks team :hand:
Incident Bot: Incident 3409876543 status: mitigated -> monitoring. Closing notifications to oncall sequence in 30m if stable.
